author: Fextralife
description:
Fable Gameplay FIRST LOOK - Impressions and Features Explained
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you guys some new gameplay from Fable that Xbox just published on their channel. I'm going to be giving some commentary on this as the video rolls through. You will hear narration from people that are invovled in the project as the video goes through, but I will be doing a little bit of voiceover here and there, kind of pointing out this I'm noticing as we make our way through the gameplay.
